findings.title: Purchase edits can drive inventory negative after dependent sales
findings.impact: Realtime inventory can become negative when a purchase with already-sold stock is edited down, violating stock correctness and weakening sales sufficiency guarantees.
findings.remediation: Before replacing purchase movements, calculate affected product deltas and reject edits that would leave stock below zero, then add a MockMvc regression covering purchase reduction after sales.

findings.remediation: Provide reproducible frontend dependencies and a successful npm run build result; ensure the manifest declares the TypeScript/Vite/React type tooling needed by the TSX app.

findings.title: Required REST API coverage is still incomplete around edit/detail and negative business paths
findings.impact: Several required business REST behaviors can regress without failing the backend API suite.
findings.remediation: Add focused API tests for category detail, product edit, purchase/sales detail, duplicate document numbers, inactive product rejection, and purchase edit stock reconciliation.
